component.name: WhatsDesk
component.summary: Unofficial desktop client for WhatsApp Web

description.p: WhatsDesk runs WhatsApp Web in its own window, separate from your browser tabs, with the features the web version is missing on Linux.

ul.li: Minimizes to the system tray and keeps running in the background
Native desktop notifications and an unread badge on the window and tray icon
Privacy "Boss Mode": blur the window instantly with Ctrl+Shift+B
Chromium sandbox and context isolation enabled, no Node integration for web content

description.p: WhatsDesk is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to WhatsApp or Meta. WhatsApp is a trademark of WhatsApp LLC.
